acceptance_criteria.text: The loopback local account reconciliation endpoint obtains account, positions, open orders, and clock through AlpacaPaperAccountClient using simulated PAPER-shaped responses, then exposes the production adapter's normalized AccountState.

The simulated transport is in-memory, rejects unexpected hosts/routes, uses no real credential lookup or external network, and proves adapter failure injection and recovery without changing the production PAPER endpoint.
Local provider health and logs/traces reflect simulated adapter reconciliation success and injected failures with sanitized observations.
